gaps.explanation: Statement transfers_out 72,272 = p5 Total Governmental Funds 'Tranfers from (to) other funds' (72,272), which nets General Fund (147,272) with Street Fund 75,000. Detail records them gross per fund: General Fund Transfers to other funds (147,272) (p9, detail index for General 'Transfers Out') and Street Fund Transfers from other funds 75,000 (p10, 'Transfers In'). Net of detail -147,272 + 75,000 = -72,272 = statement. Gap -75,000 = the Street Fund transfer in that the Total column nets out (the remaining 72,272 went to the Sewer Fund, p7). Both detail labels are the right way round. No fix.

p7 Statement of Revenues, Expenses, and Changes in Net Position - Modified Cash Basis - Proprietary Funds prints two fund columns (Water Fund, Sewer Fund) with no schedule lines in detail[]. JSON statement receipts = Sales + Other revenue + nonoperating Grant income. Water Fund: Sales 84,163 + Other revenue 770 + Grant income 180,884 = 265,817; Sewer Fund: Sales 84,636. 265,817 + 84,636 = 350,453 = statement total = gap. Check: 0 + 350,453 = 350,453.
